text: Fixed on local main ac855c9. Root cause: geomSegment/geomTile (and rect/errorBar/ribbon/area/independent layers) are inheritMapping=false and snapshot the mapping, so a plot-level continuous position scale never reached their direct x/y; companions xEnd/xMin/xMax/yEnd/yMin/yMax were never trained or mapped. Fix: non-inheriting layers adopt the plot's continuous position scale for direct x/y (order-independent); companions train and map through the primary scale; a raw companion beside a temporal/discrete scale -> UnsupportedGeomAesthetic(geom, aesthetic). Evidence: CompanionPositionScalingSuite 8/8 JVM+JS (all 6 issue-shaped tests failed before the fix), incl. segment ends == geomPoint at same coords under a custom-break/labeler transform in both scale orders, tile bounds in scale space, consumer-shaped categorical-row raster labelled 'alpha/beta/gamma' with no guide override, refusal case. coreJVM/test 590/590. Law kit not added: behaviour is compiler-internal with no injectable extension point for a negative test; covered by regression suite. Full testAll/docs/compat at integration.
